stories.summary: Sign in at /sign-in with the platform's Cognito credentials, admit current skill-builders members, and reject non-members, invalid passwords and unverifiable callbacks without a session or users row
Create exactly one local users row per Cognito subject on first successful sign-in and reuse that same row on later and concurrent sign-ins
Refuse anonymous and expired-session page and API requests before any builder data is returned, with a 302 to the sign-in entry point for pages and a JSON 401 for APIs
Re-check the skill-builders group claim on every authoring request and deny removed or claim-less users with 403 and no builder data within one hour of group removal

Keep the builder isolated from the platform database: no client library, connection string or credential, no connection while serving requests, and startup refusal when platform database configuration is supplied
